visualCharacteristics.purpose: Form built at runtime from a JSON (spreadsheet) field definition, e.g. the newsletter subscribe form
visualCharacteristics.layout: Fields stacked, buttons grouped at the end, status message below

contentPattern.structure: one row: a link to the form definition JSON (fields sheet), optionally followed by a second link to the submit endpoint
rows: link to form JSON, optional submit endpoint link

usage: Newsletter subscribe box in the Stories section (the source used a hosted Pardot form at https://ma.volvotrucks.us/l/1038333/2023-09-06/43jv). The disclaimer text is authored as a paragraph before the block.
reuseGuidance: Use for any form defined in a spreadsheet. A newsletter form needs a fields sheet (email + submit) and a submit endpoint; the hosted Pardot form is not embedded by this block.
